note: Suggestions for owner review. Nothing here has been implemented except where marked. Choose an option per item; each choice then becomes a task.

suggestions.suggestion: Confirm shopnow047c-20 as the Partner Tag before any link is shared more widely.
Run one Special Link test per product in the enrolled Associates workflow and review its tracking report before scaling.
Pick an analytics destination. GitHub Pages cannot host the requested endpoint.
options: (a) Hosted privacy-preserving analytics with a free tier (recommended for speed)
(b) Self-hosted analytics on a server the owner controls
(c) No site analytics; rely on Associates reports only

suggestions.suggestion: Approve the five proposed events on the measurement page.
Decide how prices are handled. Showing them requires Amazon-served links or API access.
options: (a) Apply for Creators API / PA-API access, after reviewing its license terms (recommended if prices matter)
(b) Stay price-free and link to the listing (current state)

suggestions.suggestion: Decide on imagery before adding any photo.
options: (b) Program Content images, if the IP License permits them after review
(c) Owner-shot photos of products the owner holds

suggestions.suggestion: Choose the brand name, then run a trademark search.
options: (a) Keep 'Counter Check' after a trademark search
(b) Owner-supplied name after a trademark search

suggestions.suggestion: Set a publishing cadence before the next guide is written.
options: (b) One guide per month (recommended while data is thin)
(c) Only when measurement shows a gap

suggestions.suggestion: Verify the site in Google Search Console and submit sitemap.xml.
Capture dimensions and specification tables from each official listing, with dated sources, before any comparison table goes beyond titles.
Name an accountable author, or keep the team byline.
options: (a) Owner supplies an author name and bio

suggestions.suggestion: Verify the Amazon IP License notice wording before adding any notice text.
Add a 'which one is for you' chooser above the comparison table, but only after the owner confirms the two categories and the dimension data is captured.
Run a mobile pass on the category tables: larger tap targets and a sticky link to each listing.
Use Search Console and the analytics events (SG-03, SG-04) to choose the next guide from measured queries, not from instinct.
options: (b) Choose topics by editorial judgement only

suggestions.suggestion: Add a dated first-party campaign ledger row only from an authorized Associates report, so that performance is judged on evidence.
